name: Main

on:
  push:

      - main

    branches:
      - main
      - dev

  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build-test:
    name: Build and test (${{ matrix.os }})

    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - macos-latest
          - windows-latest

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - name: Set git to not perform line ending conversions
        # Tests are very sensitive to line endings, so ensure they are exactly as found
        # in the repo.
        run: |
          git config --global core.autocrlf false
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - name: Check actual EOL on disk
        run: |
          git ls-files --eol
      - uses: swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Build
        run: >
          cargo build --locked --verbose

      - name: Run tests (without coverage)
        run: >
          cargo test --verbose

  check-clippy-and-format:
    name: Check clippy and format

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - uses: swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Set up nightly toolchain
        # Cannot be `minimal` profile, need `rustfmt` and `clippy`:
        # https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup/concepts/profiles.html#profiles
        run: >
          rustup toolchain install nightly && rustup component add --toolchain
          nightly rustfmt

      - name: Print versions
        run: >
          rustc --version && cargo --version && cargo +nightly fmt --version &&
          cargo clippy --version

      - name: Check formatting
        run: >
          cargo +nightly fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Check clippy
        run: >
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- --deny
          warnings

  check-dependency-changes:
    name: Check for changes in `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock`

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          path: base
      - run: cargo tree | tee tree
        working-directory: base

      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          path: head
      - run: cargo tree | tee tree
        working-directory: head

      - name: Check for changes in dependencies
        run: diff base/tree head/tree || true

    # Set in `Cargo.toml` manually by running `cargo msrv` locally. Then verified for

    name: Verify MSRV (Minimum Supported Rust Version)

      - uses: swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2.87.22
        with:
          tool: cargo-msrv
      - run: cargo msrv verify

    name: Run benchmarks for `--glob` option

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
